rounding.empty_cac_or_payback: empty string when no new paid logos exist for that month/channel/segment slice

required_metrics.name: new_arr
required_metrics.description: Sum of end_arr_usd for rows where start_arr_usd == 0 and end_arr_usd > 0.

required_metrics.name: expansion_arr
required_metrics.description: Sum of positive end_arr_usd - start_arr_usd for accounts active at both start and end of month.

required_metrics.name: contraction_arr
required_metrics.description: Sum of positive start_arr_usd - end_arr_usd for accounts active at both start and end of month.

required_metrics.name: churned_arr
required_metrics.description: Sum of start_arr_usd for rows where start_arr_usd > 0 and end_arr_usd == 0.

required_metrics.name: mrr
required_metrics.description: Sum of end_arr_usd divided by 12 for the slice.

required_metrics.name: logo_retention_rate
required_metrics.description: Retained logos divided by starting active logos; 1.0 when there are no starting active logos.

required_metrics.name: revenue_retention_rate
required_metrics.description: Retained end ARR from the starting cohort divided by starting ARR; 1.0 when there is no starting ARR.

required_metrics.name: cac
required_metrics.description: Monthly channel spend divided by count of new paid logos in the slice. Leave empty when there are no new paid logos.

required_metrics.name: payback_months
required_metrics.description: CAC divided by monthly gross profit from average new ARR, using a fixed gross margin assumption of 0.82. Leave empty when CAC is empty.

required_metrics.name: activation_rate
required_metrics.description: Activated within 14 days divided by new paid logos; 1.0 when there are no new paid logos.

required_metrics.name: pql_to_paid_rate
required_metrics.description: paid_conversion_within_30d divided by pql_flag within the slice; 0.0 when there are no PQLs.

required_metrics.name: ticket_rate_per_100_accounts
required_metrics.description: tickets_opened divided by active end-of-month accounts, multiplied by 100; 0.0 when there are no active accounts.

required_metrics.name: p1_response_sla_rate
required_metrics.description: p1_sla_met divided by p1_tickets; 1.0 when there are no P1 tickets.

submission_api.note: Use the live audit API as the final source of truth for submission shape and acceptance.
